lwir_reflective_patch_ranges.description: LWIR spectral ranging on 8x8 patches; paper Table I reports patch mean/std against lidar median ground truth.
lwir_reflective_patch_ranges.notes: Reference values are the paper's Table I patch means/errors. Reproduction scores are computed from the public raw IHTest collect1 because the authors' processed DC2P5S1.mat cube is not released; reflective-target metrics match the core claim closely, while the low-reflectance tree constraint is harder on the raw cube.

reflective_mean_abs_error_m.description: Mean absolute range error over the reflective checkerboard targets; measures the paper's central claim of correcting reflective-target overestimation.

front_abs_error_m.description: Mean absolute range error on the nearer reflective checkerboard patch; catches methods that only work at one reflective target distance.

rear_abs_error_m.description: Mean absolute range error on the farther reflective checkerboard patch; catches methods that only work at one reflective target distance.

tree_abs_error_m.description: Mean absolute range error on the low-reflectance tree patch; discourages improving reflective targets by degrading ordinary low-reflectance scene content.

front_std_m.description: Standard deviation of range estimates on the nearer reflective patch; penalizes noisy or unstable pixelwise estimates.

rear_std_m.description: Standard deviation of range estimates on the farther reflective patch; penalizes noisy or unstable pixelwise estimates.

tree_std_m.description: Standard deviation of range estimates on the low-reflectance patch; catches methods that destabilize non-reflective regions.

reflective_median_abs_error_m.description: Median absolute range error over reflective target estimates; not reported by the paper, added as a gym robustness metric.

reflective_p90_abs_error_m.description: Ninetieth-percentile absolute range error over reflective target estimates; not reported by the paper, added to catch methods with a poor error tail.

reflective_abs_bias_m.description: Absolute signed range bias over reflective target estimates; not reported by the paper, added to penalize systematic over- or under-estimation.

invalid_fraction.description: Fraction of selected patch estimates that are missing or nonnumeric; prevents methods from hiding hard pixels by omitting predictions.
